questions.prompt: 다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
questions.passage: This is the store __________ is open 9 hours a day.
choices: who
which
when
whom
where
questions.explanation: 선행사 the store가 사물이므로 which가 적절하다.

questions.prompt: 다음 문장의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 적절하지 않은 것은?
questions.passage: He has __________ which has black eyes.
choices: a sister
a doll
a dog
a cat
a bird
questions.explanation: 주격 관계대명사 which가 쓰였으므로 선행사는 사물이나 동물이어야 한다. a sister는 사람이라 적절하지 않다.

questions.prompt: 다음 문장의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
questions.passage: She has __________ who likes to play with chickens.
choices: friends
a book
some dogs
a lot of cats
a little brother
questions.explanation: 주격 관계대명사 who의 선행사는 사람이어야 하며, 뒤의 동사가 3인칭 단수 likes이므로 단수 명사여야 한다.

questions.prompt: 다음 대화의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
questions.passage:
A: Who was Pablo Picasso?
B: He was a great artist ___________ developed Cubism.
choices: what
whom
whose
which
who
questions.explanation: 선행사 a great artist가 사람이므로 주격 관계대명사 who가 적절하다.

questions.prompt: 다음 문장의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
questions.passage: He has a dog that __________ very fast.
choices: run
to run
is run
runs
running
questions.explanation: 선행사 a dog이 3인칭 단수이므로 관계대명사절의 동사도 단수형 runs가 적절하다.

questions.prompt: 다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 알맞은 것은?
questions.passage: It is a big event for foreign people ____________ live in Korea.
choices: whose
which
whom
who
what
questions.explanation: 선행사 foreign people이 사람이므로 주격 관계대명사 who가 적절하다.

questions.prompt: 다음 문장의 빈칸에 생략된 표현으로 가장 적절한 것은?
questions.passage: I want you to meet the people _______________ working with me.
choices: who is
who are
which is
which are
that is
questions.explanation: 선행사가 사람(the people)이므로 who, 복수이므로 동사 are가 적절하다.

questions.prompt: 다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 알맞은 것은?
questions.passage: There is a lady who __________ to see you.
choices: want
wants
have wanted
wanting
to want
questions.explanation: 선행사 a lady가 3인칭 단수이므로 동사도 단수형 wants가 적절하다.

questions.prompt: 다음 중 밑줄 친 부분과 바꿔 쓸 수 있는 것은?
questions.passage: He is the scientist [[that]] invented this car.
choices: who
which
whose
of which
what
questions.explanation: 선행사 the scientist가 사람이므로 that은 who로 바꿔 쓸 수 있다.

questions.prompt: Choose the one that is suitable for the blanks ⓐ and ⓑ.
questions.passage:
• I have a brother ⓐ_________ sings well.
• This is the train ⓑ_________ goes to Busan.
choices: who
whom
which
whose
that
questions.explanation: ⓐ는 사람, ⓑ는 사물 선행사로 두 경우 모두에 쓸 수 있는 관계대명사는 that이다.

questions.prompt: 다음 문장의 빈칸에 공통으로 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
questions.passage:
• I know many people __________ are doctors.
• Susie needs a bag __________ has many pockets.
• Jessica has a brother __________ plays the violin well.
choices: that
who
which
whom
whose
questions.explanation: 사람과 사물 선행사에 공통으로 쓸 수 있는 관계대명사는 that이다.

questions.prompt: 다음 빈칸에 공통으로 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
questions.passage:
• The Coke __________ was flowing out of the bottle changed into ice.
• This is the book __________ is famous among teenagers.
choices: who
which
whom
what
whose
questions.explanation: 두 선행사 모두 사물이므로 주격 관계대명사 which가 적절하다.

questions.prompt: Choose the proper word for all the following blanks.
questions.passage:
• I have a friend __________ lives in Mexico city.
• I have neighbors __________ are very noisy.
• I live in a building __________ has very thin walls.
choices: who
that
which
whose
what
questions.explanation: 선행사의 종류에 상관없이 쓸 수 있는 관계대명사 that이 적절하다.

questions.prompt: 다음 문장의 빈칸 (A), (B)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
questions.passage:
• I know the man (A)__________ is wearing a blue jacket.
• Minsu has a book (B)__________ was a present from his friends.
choices: who - who
who - which
which - who
which - which
whom - which
questions.explanation: (A) 사람 선행사 who, (B) 사물 선행사 which가 적절하다.

questions.prompt: 다음 두 문장을 한 문장으로 만들 때, 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은? (정답2개)
questions.passage:
I have a book. It is very interesting.
→ I have a book __________ is very interesting.
choices: who
whom
which
that
what
questions.explanation: 선행사가 a book이므로 which와 that을 사용할 수 있다.

questions.prompt: 다음 중 빈칸에 들어갈 말이 차례대로 짝지어진 것은?
questions.passage:
• There are many people _________ enjoy extreme sports.
• I know a store _________ sells fresh fruits.
choices: who - whose
who - which
whom - who
whom - which
which - which
questions.explanation: 앞은 사람 선행사 who, 뒤는 사물 선행사 which가 적절하다.

questions.prompt: 다음 문장의 빈칸 (A), (B)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
questions.passage:
• Can you see the butterfly (A)__________ is on the red flowers?
• She is the lady (B)__________ is as brave as a man.
choices: that - which
that - whom
which - which
who - which
which - that
questions.explanation: (A) 동물(나비) 선행사 which/that, (B) 사람 선행사 who/that이므로 which-that이 적절하다.

questions.prompt: 다음 문장의 빈칸 (A), (B)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
questions.passage:
• Look at the child and the dog (A)__________ are running together.
• My father bought me this bag (B)__________ is expensive.
choices: that - which
who - which
that - who
which - which
who - that
questions.explanation: (A) 사람과 동물이 함께 쓰였으므로 that, (B) 사물 선행사 which가 적절하다.

questions.prompt: 다음 두 문장을 한 문장으로 고쳐 쓸 때, 빈칸 (A), (B)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
questions.passage:
(1) I have a friend. He speaks four languages.
⟶ I have a friend (A)__________ speaks four languages.
(2) I know the city. It has a beautiful river.
⟶ I know the city (B)__________ has a beautiful river.
choices: who - which
who - and
which - that
that - who
what - which
questions.explanation: (A) 사람 선행사 who, (B) 사물 선행사 which가 적절하다.

questions.prompt: 다음 문장의 빈칸 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
questions.passage:
• Turkey is a country (A)__________ has many interesting things.
• There are many animals (B)__________ live in the water.
• Mr. Lee is a person (C)__________ cares about family.
choices: which - who - who
which - which - who
who - who - which
that - which - which
who - that - whose
questions.explanation: (A) 사물 which, (B) 동물 which, (C) 사람 who가 적절하다.

questions.prompt: 다음 문장의 빈칸 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
questions.passage:
• There is a man (A)__________ wants to see you.
• Look at the house (B)__________ has a red roof.
• Every student (C)__________ is in this room looks smart.
choices: that - that - which
who - which - which
which - who - who
which - who - that
who - which - that
questions.explanation: (A) 사람 who, (B) 사물 which, (C) 사람 선행사이지만 that이 적절하다.

questions.prompt: 다음 우리말을 바르게 영작한 것은?
questions.passage: 나는 기타를 잘 치는 소년을 알고 있다.
choices: I know a boy which play the guitar.
I know a boy who play the guitar.
I know a boy which the guitar plays.
I know a boy who plays the guitar well.
I know a boy which plays the guitar well.
questions.explanation: 선행사 a boy가 사람이므로 who, 단수 동사 plays가 적절하다.

questions.prompt: 다음 우리말을 바르게 영작한 것은?
questions.passage: 나는 많은 정보가 있는 책들을 좋아한다.
choices: I like books who has a lot of informations.
I like books which have lot of informations.
I like books which have a lot of information.
I like books who have a lot of informations.
I like books which have a lot of informations.
questions.explanation: 선행사가 사물(books)이므로 which, 복수 동사 have, information은 불가산 명사이다.

questions.prompt: 다음 두 문장을 한 문장으로 바르게 연결한 것은?
questions.passage:
• I know the people.
• They are in the bookstore.
choices: I know the people who in the bookstore.
I know the people that is in the bookstore.
I know the people who is in the bookstore.
I know the people who are in the bookstore.
I know the people that they are in the bookstore.
questions.explanation: 선행사 the people이 복수이므로 who 뒤에 복수동사 are가 적절하다.

questions.prompt: 다음 두 문장을 한 문장으로 바르게 연결한 것은?
questions.passage:
• Kim is in the hospital.
• He was injured yesterday.
choices: Kim is in the hospital who was injured yesterday.
Kim is in the hospital which was injured yesterday.
Kim who was injured yesterday is in the hospital.
Kim which was injured yesterday is in the hospital.
Kim who was injured is in the hospital yesterday.
questions.explanation: 선행사 Kim 바로 뒤에 관계대명사절 who was injured yesterday가 와야 한다.

questions.prompt: 다음 두 문장을 한 문장으로 바르게 연결한 것은?
questions.passage:
• I have an electronic dictionary.
• It is very useful.
choices: I have an electronic dictionary and is very useful.
I have an electronic dictionary what is very useful.
I have an electronic dictionary which is very useful.
I have an electronic dictionary whose is very useful.
I have an electronic dictionary who is very useful.
questions.explanation: 선행사가 사물이므로 주격 관계대명사 which로 연결한다.

questions.prompt: 다음 두 문장을 한 문장으로 바르게 연결한 것은?
questions.passage:
• The house is David's house.
• The house has a green window.
choices: The house is David's house when has a green window.
The house which has a green window is David's house.
The house is a green house that David lives in.
The house is David's house who has a green window.
The house which has a green window is David.
questions.explanation: 선행사 The house 뒤에 관계대명사 which절이 와야 하며 의미상 ②가 적절하다.

questions.prompt: 다음 두 문장을 한 문장으로 바르게 연결한 것은?
questions.passage:
• The boy is in the hospital.
• He was injured yesterday.
choices: The boy is in the hospital who was injured yesterday.
The boy is in the hospital which was injured yesterday.
The boy who was injured yesterday is in the hospital.
The boy which was injured yesterday is in the hospital.
The boy who was injured is in the hospital yesterday.
questions.explanation: 선행사 The boy 바로 뒤에 관계대명사절 who was injured yesterday가 와야 한다.

questions.prompt: 다음 두 문장을 한 문장으로 바르게 연결한 것은? (정답2개)
questions.passage:
• Ji-Yong likes Jae-Yeon.
• She has beautiful hands.
choices: Ji-Yong likes Jae-Yeon which has beautiful hands.
Ji-Yong likes Jae-Yeon that has beautiful hands.
Ji-Yong likes Jae-Yeon whom has beautiful hands.
Ji-Yong likes Jae-Yeon of which has beautiful hands.
Ji-Yong likes Jae-Yeon who has beautiful hands.
questions.explanation: 선행사가 사람이므로 관계대명사 who[that]으로 연결한다.

questions.prompt: 다음 <보기>에 주어진 단어들을 바르게 배열하여 문장을 완성한 것은?
questions.passage: <보기> your / anything / find / can / that / tricks / you / eyes / ?
choices: Can you find anything that tricks your eyes?
Can you anything find that tricks your eyes?
Can you find that anything tricks your eyes?
Can you tricks anything find that your eyes?
Can you find tricks that anything your eyes?
questions.explanation: 선행사 anything 다음에 「관계대명사+동사+목적어」의 형태로 배열한다.

questions.prompt: 다음 두 문장을 한 문장으로 쓸 때, 알맞은 것을 고르면?
questions.passage:
• The man has just left.
• He gave this letter to me.
choices: The man gave this letter to me who has just left.
The man who gave this letter to me has just left.
The man gave this letter which has just left to me.
The man which gave this letter to me has just left.
The man has just left that gave this letter to me.
questions.explanation: 선행사 The man 바로 뒤에 관계대명사절 who gave this letter to me가 와야 한다.

questions.prompt: 다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
questions.passage: I want to buy a new camera _____________________.
choices: who has beautiful colors
when I lost yesterday
which it is very cheap
that looks like a cell phone
that the shop sells it
questions.explanation: 선행사 a new camera가 사물이므로 which/that을 쓰며, 주격 관계대명사절은 주어가 없는 불완전한 절(동사는 단수 수일치)이어야 한다.

questions.prompt: 다음 중 빈칸에 which가 들어갈 수 없는 것은?
choices: She has two cats _______ are white.
There is a store _______ sells cute pets.
Pass me the sugar _______ is on the table.
He has a book _______ has beautiful pictures.
Kevin is the actor _______ can speak Japanese.
questions.explanation: ⑤의 선행사 the actor는 사람이므로 who를 쓴다.

questions.prompt: 다음 중 빈칸에 who가 들어갈 수 없는 것은?
choices: He is the boy _________ ran to me.
Look at the monkey ________ has a banana in its hand.
He is the man _________ can speak Korean.
The lady _________ is wearing a coat is my aunt.
Mr. Kim has a son _________ speaks five languages.
questions.explanation: ②의 선행사 the monkey는 동물이므로 which를 쓴다.

questions.prompt: 다음 중 빈칸에 who가 들어갈 수 없는 것은?
choices: There is a sister _______ can play the piano well.
Look at the girl and the cat _______ are sleeping under the tree.
I met the students _______ go to Wonil Middle School.
The person _______ invented Hangeul is King Sejong.
There are lots of people _______ don't have enough water.
questions.explanation: ②는 선행사에 사람과 동물이 함께 있으므로 that을 쓴다.

questions.prompt: 다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말이 나머지 넷과 다른 하나는? (단, that은 제외할 것)
choices: I know a girl ______ likes snakes.
He has a friend ______ is a singer.
Look at the sky ______ has no clouds.
She has an aunt ______ lives in Japan.
We need a man ______ can teach us Chinese.
questions.explanation: ③은 선행사가 사물이므로 which, 나머지는 사람이므로 who를 쓴다.

questions.prompt: 다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말이 나머지 넷과 다른 하나는? (단, that은 제외할 것)
choices: He is one of the scientists _______ are respected.
He is the boy _______ won the contest.
He bought a table _______ was made of wood.
She is the nurse _______ took care of me.
She had three sons _______ became soldiers.
questions.explanation: ③은 선행사가 사물(a table)이므로 which, 나머지는 사람이므로 who를 쓴다.

questions.prompt: 다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말이 나머지 넷과 다른 하나는? (단, that은 제외할 것)
choices: This is the picture _______ Sumi painted.
Here is the book _______ you gave me.
The dog _______ is sleeping on the sofa is mine.
I love this house _______ is built by my father.
He has two sons _______ became scientists.
questions.explanation: ⑤는 선행사가 사람(two sons)이므로 who, 나머지는 사물/동물이므로 which를 쓴다.

questions.prompt: 다음 밑줄 친 who의 쓰임이 나머지와 다른 것은?
choices: Judy is the girl [[who]] won the science contest.
[[Who]] is the man standing next to you in this photo?
She isn't sure [[who]] she talked to.
[[Who]] will be the next president?
[[Who]] do you respect most?
questions.explanation: ①은 주격 관계대명사 who, 나머지는 의문사 who이다.

questions.prompt: 다음 중 밑줄 친 which의 쓰임이 나머지와 다른 것은?
choices: [[Which]] one of the two is your brother?
Please tell me [[which]] car he wants to buy.
I don't know [[which]] boy is Matt.
She asked me [[which]] medicine to choose.
Look at the dog [[which]] is following him.
questions.explanation: ⑤는 주격 관계대명사, 나머지는 의문형용사이다.

questions.prompt: 다음 중 밑줄 친 who의 쓰임이 나머지와 다른 것은?
choices: I can't tell [[who]] wrote the letter.
Do you know [[who]] the woman is?
[[Who]] is the man with a white shirt?
The man [[who]] works for me is very nice.
[[Who]] do you think the woman is?
questions.explanation: ④는 주격 관계대명사, 나머지는 의문대명사이다.

questions.prompt: 다음 중 밑줄 친 who의 쓰임이 나머지와 다른 것은?
choices: Guess [[who]] this is?
[[Who]] is that woman?
Do you know [[who]] the winner is?
I don't remember [[who]] that girl is.
He is the boy [[who]] broke the window.
questions.explanation: ⑤는 주격 관계대명사, 나머지는 의문사이다.

questions.prompt: 다음 중 밑줄 친 부분의 쓰임이 다른 하나는?
choices: Do you know [[who]] my homeroom teacher is?
There was a small village [[that]] grew into a city.
Peter gave me a purse [[which]] was made of paper.
I know a woman [[who]] climbed Mt. Everest.
People [[who]] stayed on high floors couldn't escape.
questions.explanation: ①은 의문사, 나머지는 주격 관계대명사이다.

questions.prompt: 다음 중 밑줄 친 부분의 쓰임이 <보기>와 같은 것은?
questions.passage: <보기> I can create a scene that shows a lot of people.
choices: Where did you buy [[that]]?
I know [[that]] Jane came from Japan.
Are you worried [[that]] the floor is cold?
The boy [[that]] is singing a song is my friend.
Do you think [[that]] Jane can speak two languages?
questions.explanation: 보기의 that은 주격 관계대명사로 ④와 쓰임이 같다. ①은 지시대명사, ②③⑤는 접속사이다.

questions.prompt: 다음 중 밑줄 친 부분의 쓰임이 다른 하나는?
choices: Look at the church [[that]] stands on the hill.
There is a little cafe [[that]] sells very good coffee.
She believes [[that]] the rumor is true.
I bought a vest [[that]] has many pockets.
She always asks me questions [[that]] are difficult to answer.
questions.explanation: ③은 명사절 접속사 that, 나머지는 관계대명사 that이다.

questions.prompt: 다음 중 밑줄 친 부분의 쓰임이 <보기>와 같은 것은? (정답 2개)
questions.passage: <보기> A boy that called last night didn't leave his number.
choices: [[That]] boy is my brother.
This is more popular than [[that]].
Is he the boy [[that]] is very honest?

questions.prompt: 다음 중 우리말을 영어로 바르게 옮긴 것은?
choices: 만약 내가 그 책을 다 읽으면 너에게 그것을 빌려줄게. → If I finish the book, I'll lend it to you.
만약 네가 그것을 혼자 나르지 못한다면, 내가 너를 도와줄 수 있어. → I can help you if you will not carry it.
만약 네가 지금 떠나지 않는다면 너는 늦을 것이다. → If you won't leave now, you'll be late.
만약 내일 눈이 내린다면, 나는 집에 머무를 것이다. → If it snow tomorrow, I'll stay at home.
만약 그가 내일 아침에 아침 식사를 하지 않는다면, 그는 수업 중에 배가 고플 것이다. → He is hungry if he doesn't eat breakfast tomorrow morning.
questions.explanation: ② will not→don't, ③ won't leave→don't leave, ④ it snow→it snows, ⑤ He is→He will be로 고쳐야 한다. ①이 올바르다.

questions.prompt: 다음 중 밑줄 친 if가 옳게 쓰인 문장은?
